properties.label: Complete archival specimen grid
properties.text: Arrange many tiny specimens as a meticulously spaced contact sheet beneath a narrow heading and beside a compact fill legend.

properties.label: Narrow serif with compact legend
properties.text: Use a narrow editorial serif for the collection heading and compact, readable labels for the specimen legend and archive metadata.

properties.label: Cream paper and mode-coded fills
properties.text: Use cream paper and black ink, with restrained fill variation encoding light, dark and mixed source modes.

properties.label: Print-scale specimen marks
properties.text: Give every tile a subtle ruled border, inset neutral mark and fine registration texture that remains coherent at print scale.

properties.label: Quiet contact-sheet scan
properties.text: If motion is used, let one very quiet scanning band traverse the fixed grid; never animate individual tiles as a wave.

properties.label: Explicit archive date and count
properties.text: Keep the archive date and specimen count explicit and ensure the grid total reconciles with the legend.

properties.label: Complete archive reflow
properties.text: At mobile widths reduce the number of columns while preserving every specimen instead of cropping the archive.
